messages:
maya: uploaded quantized v2 weights to s3://redwood-models/prod/llama-v2-q8_2026-03-15
maya: also pushed tokenizer files to the same prefix (/tokenizer/*). can someone sanity-check the vocab and the special tokens? :eyes:
maya: the serving config I used is below — this is what Dedicated will start with unless we tweak
maya: ```
service: llama-v2
variant: q8_0
tokenizer_path: s3://redwood-models/prod/llama-v2-q8_2026-03-15/tokenizer
max_seq_len: 4096
bos_token: "<s>"
eos_token: "</s>"
structured_output: true
tool_calling: enabled
rollout: canary(10%)
``` 
leo: quick look — tokenizer vocab size looks right (50288). but noticed there are duplicated entries for "<s>" and "</s>" in merges. could cause tokenization mismatch when using prefix caching.
leo: small repro: ``python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('<s>test').tokens)"`` — returned ['<s>', '<s>', 'test'] instead of ['<s>', 'test']
arjun: thanks — that's the tokenizer quirk I mentioned on the PR. I ran the bpe normalizer and one of the merges got applied twice during conversion from hf->json.
arjun: simple fix is to strip duplicate special tokens in the conversion script. pushing a hotfix to my branch now.
maya: good catch. rachel, FYI this may affect our golden prompts that assume a single leading BOS when we do KV-prefix caching in the runtime.
rachel: noted. I'll re-run the golden-suite locally against the canary config once the hotfix lands. pinging squad-runner-bot to enqueue the regression job.
squad-runner-bot: queued: run=golden-suite, model=llama-v2-q8_2026-03-15, config=canary. CI job: https://ci.redwood/invoke/29821 :white_check_mark:
devops-bot: deploy-preview created for dedicated canary -> https://deploys.redwood/inv/preview-789
leo: also saw one failing structured output test — the JSON schema validator failed on the tool metadata field (extra key "confidence_score")
maya: we expect tool outputs to be strictly {"name":string, "args":object}. confidence_score should be removed or moved under args.
arjun: adding a test in eval harness to enforce schema. will link PR shortly.
arjun: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/613 — fixes tokenizer conversion + adds schema check
maya: can folks +1 the PR and the hotfix so I can cut a new model package and re-run the golden-suite? :pray:
leo: +1. ran a quick local against the patched tokenizer — tokens now look correct.
rachel: +1 from me. I'll monitor the golden-suite run and post failures here.
squad-runner-bot: update: golden-suite started. expected runtime ~18m. logs -> https://ci.redwood/logs/29821
maya: thanks everyone. if golden-suite is green we'll flip the canary rollout in 30m and bump the Dedicated config. if any regression shows up we'll rollback to q8_0-2026-02-28.
rachel: golden-suite finished: 18m 12s — 49/50 tests passed. failing test is tool-calling/structured/json-schema (same confidence_score issue) — requeued with latest infra PR.
squad-runner-bot: re-run queued: run=golden-suite, model=llama-v2-q8_2026-03-15, config=canary, change=infra#613
squad-runner-bot: re-run finished: 50/50 passed :tada:
maya: awesome. rolling canary to 100% in 10m unless anybody objects.
leo: no objections. :thumbsup:
arjun: lgtm — will watch metrics after rollout for tokenization-related spike.
rachel: i'll check structured-output regression dashboard and the fallback logs in case of parse errors.
maya: deploying now. will post final status in ~15m.
maya: deploy completed — Dedicated canary->stable. routing updated. :rocket:
maya: post-deploy checks: latency +0.2ms p50, cost per token unchanged, no increase in parse errors. closing this thread. :wave:
